flyer.justification: The flyer captures the main theme well, but the title exceeds the 6-word maximum requirement.

linkedin.justification: The post adheres to all LinkedIn formatting constraints and effectively conveys the talk's core insights without forbidden filler words.

instagram.justification: Follows all Instagram formatting guidelines including carousel cues, emoji styling, CTA, and hashtag counts.

summary.justification: Well-structured executive briefing that complies with the sub-400-word limit and required Markdown components.

newsletter.justification: Meets all email newsletter requirements, including subject line length, three bold subheadings, and conversational tone.

blog.justification: The blog misidentifies the Waorani tribe as 'Warao', omits the required numbered sections, and misses a dedicated 'About the Author' section.
